name: B10-0390/2026 – After § 5 – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on narco-trafficking in Europe’s waters: protecting our borders and supporting our law enforcement officers
part_text: 5a. Encourages the Member States to review and, where necessary, amend their national legal and operational frameworks governing the use of force by law enforcement, border and coast guard personnel, in order to ensure that officers are clearly authorised and adequately protected when using firearms in situations where there is any kind of risk of death or serious injury to themselves or others, including where criminal vessels deliberately ram the vessels of, attack or otherwise pose any kind of threat to law enforcement personnel when refusing to comply with their orders;
